summary_en: Title search, escrow, deeds and the legal chain of a transfer.
summary_fr: Recherche de titre, séquestre, actes et chaîne juridique de la mutation.

tools.name: Docusign
tools.positioning: The e-signature the US real estate transaction standardised on, now extended into contract lifecycle management.
tools.description: Docusign provides electronic signature, document generation, contract lifecycle management and notarisation. In real estate it is distributed both directly and through association-branded editions bundled with transaction platforms.
tools.real_estate_use: In the United States, the purchase agreement, addenda and disclosures are almost always signed here, often from inside dotloop, SkySlope or a forms platform rather than from Docusign's own interface. On the commercial side, contract lifecycle management is used for lease negotiation and clause approval across a portfolio.
features: Electronic signature with audit trail and authentication options
Templates and reusable document packages
Contract lifecycle management with clause libraries
Remote online notarisation in supported jurisdictions
Deep integration into real estate transaction platforms
API and connectors across business software

use_cases.job: Get a purchase agreement and its addenda signed from inside the transaction platform
Manage lease negotiation and clause approval across a portfolio

capabilities: Contract clause extraction and risk review

tools.name: GenApi
tools.positioning: Practice management for French notaries — where the deed, the file and the office accounting are one system.
tools.description: GenApi, part of Septeo, publishes software for French notarial offices: file and deed production, clause and act libraries, client and party records, notarial accounting, electronic filing with the profession's infrastructure and secure exchange with administrations.
tools.real_estate_use: In France the notaire, not a title company, carries the property transfer: drafting the acte authentique, collecting taxes, and registering with the service de publicité foncière. GenApi is one of the systems that production runs in, which makes it a structural dependency of every French property sale even though no agent ever logs into it.
features: Notarial file and deed production with maintained act libraries
Party, property and origin-of-title records
Notarial accounting including client funds
Electronic exchange with the profession's platforms and administrations
Tax calculation and filing for property transfers
Document archiving to notarial retention requirements

use_cases.job: Draft, execute and register an acte authentique with its accounting and taxes
Keep client funds accounting to the standard the profession requires

tools.name: iNot
tools.positioning: The notarial software published from inside the profession's own technical body.
tools.description: iNot is a suite for French notarial offices published by ADNOV, the technology subsidiary of the notariat's own infrastructure group: deed and file production, office management, accounting, and connection to the profession's shared services and registers.
tools.real_estate_use: Its distinguishing characteristic is proximity to the profession's central infrastructure — the registers, the secure exchange network and the electronic authentic deed. For an office, that means the chain from drafting to registration stays within one technical ecosystem rather than crossing vendor boundaries at each step.
features: Notarial deed and file production
Office and client management
Notarial accounting and client funds handling
Connection to the profession's shared registers and services
Electronic authentic deed workflows
Secure inter-office exchange

use_cases.job: Produce and register deeds inside the profession's own technical ecosystem
Exchange files securely with other offices on a shared transaction

tools.name: Modelo
tools.positioning: French real estate legal drafting kept current with the law — mandates, leases and offers generated rather than copied from an old file.
tools.description: Modelo produces legal documents for French real estate professionals: mandates, purchase offers, compromis, leases and their annexes, generated from a clause library maintained against current legislation, with electronic signature and file management.
tools.real_estate_use: French real estate law changes often enough that the biggest documentary risk in an agency is the template someone saved in 2019. Modelo's proposition is that the clause library is maintained centrally: when a legal obligation changes, the generated document changes, and the agency does not have to notice.
features: Legally maintained clause library for French real estate documents
Mandate, offer, compromis and lease generation
Annex assembly including mandatory disclosures
Electronic signature integration
Document file management per transaction
Updates tracking legislative change

use_cases.job: Produce a mandate or compromis that reflects the law as it stands today
Generate leases and annexes with the current mandatory disclosures attached

tools.name: Qualia
tools.positioning: Title and escrow production software where the lender, the agent and the buyer work inside the same closing file.
tools.description: Qualia is a title, escrow and closing platform: order management and title production, escrow accounting and reconciliation, document generation, a secure portal for all parties, remote online notarisation and digital closings, plus a marketplace of title services.
tools.real_estate_use: A US closing coordinates a title agent, a lender, two brokerages and a buyer, historically through email and fax. Qualia gives them one file: the buyer uploads identity documents and wiring instructions through a secure portal — which is also the main defence against wire fraud, the industry's most expensive failure — and escrow accounting reconciles inside the same system.
features: Title order management and production workflow
Escrow accounting with three-way reconciliation
Secure multi-party closing portal with document exchange
Wire fraud protection and verified wiring instructions
Remote online notarisation and digital closing
Marketplace for title search and settlement services

use_cases.job: Run title production and escrow accounting in one auditable system
Track a closing file and its outstanding conditions without email chains

tools.name: ResWare
tools.positioning: Title production for high-volume operations, where the workflow engine matters more than the interface.
tools.description: ResWare is a title and escrow production platform aimed at large agencies and national operations, built around a configurable workflow and automation engine with extensive partner integrations and API-driven order exchange.
tools.real_estate_use: A national title operation processes orders from many lenders, each with its own service level and document requirements. ResWare is chosen for the rules engine that routes and automates those variations at volume, and for API-based order intake that lets a lender place and track orders without a human touching them.
features: Configurable workflow and automation rules engine
API-driven order intake and status exchange with lenders
Escrow accounting and disbursement controls
Document generation and policy production
Vendor and partner network integration
Volume reporting and service level tracking

use_cases.job: Automate title order routing across many lender workflows at volume
Place and track title orders through an API rather than by email

tools.name: SoftPro
tools.positioning: The long-established title production system, built around state-by-state form and settlement requirements.
tools.description: SoftPro is closing, title and escrow production software: settlement statement preparation including the Closing Disclosure, document and form libraries by jurisdiction, escrow accounting and trust reconciliation, order tracking and title policy production.
tools.real_estate_use: Settlement is a jurisdictional exercise: forms, recording requirements and disbursement rules differ by state and often by county. SoftPro's depth in that form and rule library is what keeps it installed in title agencies that have used it for decades, alongside escrow trust accounting that survives a state audit.
features: Settlement statement and Closing Disclosure preparation
Jurisdiction-specific document and form libraries
Escrow trust accounting with reconciliation
Title policy and commitment production
Order tracking and workflow automation
Integrations with underwriters and recording services

use_cases.job: Produce compliant settlement documents for the specific state and county
Keep escrow trust accounts reconciled to audit standard

tools.name: Yousign
tools.positioning: European electronic signature with eIDAS qualification — the French default where a signature must hold in a French court.
tools.description: Yousign is a French electronic signature and contract platform: simple, advanced and qualified signature levels under eIDAS, identity verification, approval workflows, templates, audit trails and an API, with data hosted in the European Union.
tools.real_estate_use: Mandates, lease agreements, offers and état des lieux are all signed remotely now, and the question that matters is evidentiary weight. eIDAS levels are not decoration: a qualified signature carries a legal presumption a simple one does not. French agency software integrates Yousign for exactly that reason, alongside the EU hosting requirement many professional bodies impose.
features: Simple, advanced and qualified eIDAS signature levels
Signer identity verification
Reusable document templates and signature workflows
Legally admissible audit trail per signature
API and connectors to business software
European Union data hosting

use_cases.job: Have a mandate or offer signed remotely with a signature that holds legally
Sign leases and état des lieux with tenants without a physical appointment
